nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, $\mathrm{BS}(1, n)$ is the group with presentation $\langle a, b \mid b a b^{-1} = a^n \rangle$.
nodes.title: The Baumslag–Solitar group BS(1, n)

nodes.summary: A group $G$ is locally subgroup-separable, or LERF, when every finitely generated subgroup of $G$ is separable.
nodes.title: Locally subgroup-separable (LERF) group

nodes.summary: A subgroup $H$ of a group $G$ is separable when for every element $x \in G$ with $x \notin H$ there are a finite group $F$ and a group homomorphism $f \colon G \to F$ with $f(x) \notin f(H)$.
nodes.title: Separable subgroup

nodes.summary: There is a finitely generated solvable group $G$ for which the following two conditions are not equivalent: $G$ is locally subgroup-separable; there is no $n > 1$ such that $G$ has a subgroup isomorphic to the Baumslag–Solitar group $\mathrm{BS}(1, n)$.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 16.2 has a negative answer

nodes.summary: A finitely generated solvable group $G$ is locally subgroup-separable if and only if there is no $n > 1$ such that $G$ has a subgroup isomorphic to the Baumslag–Solitar group $\mathrm{BS}(1, n)$.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 16.2 (R. C. Alperin)

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
